name: F7_ungroup_after_aggregations_over_vectors
description: Task 12.1, F7. Three ungroups that Java fails and Oxhaven serves. f5: a second ungroup of a column that the first took out of the distinct of a vector column (NullPointerException). u: ungroup with null fill of an aggregation grouped by a vector column, whose key vector has more elements than its group column: reading A8 fails (Assertion failed: asserted first <= last). p: ungroup with null fill where the shorter column is the vector of a distinct aggregation: reading D fails (ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException in IntSegmentedSortedMultiset#get); this one needs no vector column and is not new with this task. Oxhaven answers f5 with the elements and u and p with nulls for the missing elements.
